messages:
Elaine: Quick sync — Austin Summit next week. We have three open items: 1) swag shipment ETA; 2) final speaker slides/benchmark narrative; 3) inbound lead routing + webinar follow-up cadence. Need owners and blockers. @mike can you confirm swag? @sam can you own lead routing? :pray:
Mike: Swag — vendor emailed, shipping label created, ETA Wed 10am. They missed one SKU (stickers). I filed RMA. Should we replace with extra polos? :thinking:
Elaine: If stickers delayed, yes replace with 50 extra polos. Budget ok. @jules can you approve?
Jules: approving now. Send me cost estimate.
Mike: cost est: $420. I'll attach invoice link: https://orders.vendor/INV-420
Sam: Lead routing: can do. Proposal: capture leads on iPad (Typeform), route via Zapier to SFDC lead queue 'events/austin', tag source=austin_summit, assign to SalesOps round-robin. Also send instant follow-up email with webinar sign-up CTA.
Elaine: Perfect. Can you paste the Zapier filter + SFDC mapping here? We need the exact field names for SalesOps to pre-map.
Sam: mapping:
```
name -> Lead.Name
email -> Lead.Email
company -> Lead.Company
notes -> Lead.Description
source -> Lead.Source = 'austin_summit'
```
Filter: email exists && opt_in = true
I'll create the Zap and share editor access to @jules and @mike by EOD.
Jules: also add tag 'benchmark_interested' if they choose 'benchmarks' in interests field.
Elaine: Slides/benchmark narrative: @maria shared draft last week but we still need a 2-slide summary for the booth screen and a one-paragraph press blurb for the post. Who can own condensing?
Sam: I can take the 2-slide summary. @maria pls drop the draft in this thread.
Maria: posted draft here: https://drive.redwood/summit/benchmarks-draft v1
Maria: note: numbers use internal perf run v1.2 — need legal ok before public.
Jules: Legal check started, ETA tomorrow noon. Do not publish slides until confirmed.
Elaine: Ok — contingency: if legal not cleared, show generic "Redwood Inference — Production-grade LLM inference" slide + CTA.
Ops-bot: Reminder — logistics deadline: submit booth proof by 48hrs before ship cutoff. https://ops.redwood/booth-deadlines
Mike: I'll upload proof by tomorrow morning.
Elaine: Follow-up cadence for leads: immediate email (webinar CTA), 3-day nurture (benchmarks case study), 10-day sales touch. @sam will owner drip content.
Sam: Yep — I'll draft emails and post to the thread for copy edits.
Elaine: Great. Last ask: badge scanning fallback — if iPad app fails, capture paper list and scan post-event. @mike bring extra chargers. :battery:
Mike: noted. Packing list: iPad, chargers (2x), backup hotspot, business cards (200), polos (80), pop-up banners (2).
Jules: Logistics: confirm arrival window at venue with shipping team. I have contact: laura@venue.com
Elaine: Thanks team. Sync 10am tomorrow to confirm proofs & Zap share. :white_check_mark:
